operation_details.item: The user leads the due diligence workstream for the LogiCore acquisition.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy, but manageable. I’m leading the due diligence workstream for the LogiCore acquisition.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a substantial piece of the deal. Is the review focused mainly on the numbers, or does it include legal as well?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Both financial and legal areas. We also have external counsel engaged to support the deal.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good to have that coverage. Are you working toward a specific board milestone?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the board decision deadline is the end of the quarter, so we’re keeping the workstream tightly coordinated.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Keeping the financial findings, legal issues, and board narrative aligned will be important.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’m focused on making the diligence output decision-ready rather than just comprehensive.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that I lead the LogiCore due diligence workstream, but keep the scope, counsel, and deadline details.
